newsitem.title: USA: U.S. veteran kills himself in congressman's office.
newsitem.headline: U.S. veteran kills himself in congressman's office.

text.p: A Vietnam War veteran believed to be suffering from post-traumatic stress syndrome shot and killed himself in a California congressman's office on Monday, police said.

The ex-Marine, in his 40s, was leaving the San Mateo, California office of Democratic Representative Tom Lantos after conducting some business there when he pulled out a gun and killed himself with a shot to the chest, a police spokesman said.
Lantos was not in the office, 15 miles (25 km) south of San Francisco, at the time and no one was injured, police said. The motive for the shooting was under investigation.
